review_items.rationale: Applicability: The obligation is conditional on no contact with a required remote voter and an already-expired prior marker. The public lease contract supports role loss in that condition. Counting a real negative heartbeat as contact is an alternative outside the no-response antecedent. This interpretation does not require every pipeline error to imply no receiver processing; the harness independently supplies no receiver worker. Decomposition: Real timeout publication -> real pipeline consumer -> contact marker -> actual lease decision addresses the selected A2 relation. The oracle observes role after lease consumption, not merely the response-interface mismatch. Ordinary timeout is an independent comparison. Even if this obligation held, stale reads or incorrect commits could still arise through other mechanisms; it is not sufficient for overall correctness. Checker correspondence: Saved checker selects independent lease_result events, correlates operation with prefix and completed events, and asserts State == Follower. Raw execution has no parse errors, correlated results 3 and 7, pipeline command timed out with same_request=true, actual contact refresh and Leader result, plus ordinary timeout unchanged contact and Follower result. Completion is awaited before result; receiver processing/replies are structurally absent; result is not a prerequisite. However saved harness uses DefaultConfig (HeartbeatTimeout and ElectionTimeout 1s), sets LeaderLeaseTimeout to 2s, then bypasses ValidateConfig by storing config directly. config.go rejects lease greater than heartbeat. This prevents attribution to a supported configuration even though the local measurement is intact. Repair by setting HeartbeatTimeout and ElectionTimeout to at least 2s, calling ValidateConfig before execution, retaining lease 2s, prior contact 4s, oracle, prerequisites and actual transport paths. Fresh execution and focused review must resolve this issue; a source-only assurance is insufficient.
